create_DPCoordinator: create a DPCoordinator instance for data-parallel vLLM deployments with a ParallelConfig
get_stats_publish_address: get the stats publish address from a DPCoordinator for front-end load-balancing
get_engine_socket_addresses: get the ZMQ input and output socket addresses from a DPCoordinator for engine communication
run_coordinator: run the DPCoordinatorProc in a separate process to coordinate multiple DP engine ranks
shutdown_DPCoordinator: shutdown a DPCoordinator process with an optional timeout
